title: Await direct coroutine calls
why: Calling an async function without awaiting, returning, or scheduling its coroutine leaves the intended work unexecuted.
suggestion: Await the coroutine, return it to the caller, or schedule it through structured concurrency.
limitations: Only direct expression-statement calls to async functions declared in the same file are reported.
Awaited, returned, assigned, collected, scheduler-wrapped, and multiline enclosing-expression calls are excluded.
Imported coroutines and dynamically resolved methods are not inferred.
